svg.text: From trade to aggregate add-on — Basel CRE52 / EU CRR Art. 277–280a
Trades in the netting set whose primary risk driver is an interest rate
(CRR: a trade can belong to more than one risk category)
Assign hedging set and time bucket
Hedging set: one per currency; basis and volatility trades in separate sets
Bucket by end date E: 1) E < 1y 2) 1y ≤ E ≤ 5y 3) E > 5y
S, E = start and end dates in years (for a swaption: of the underlying swap)
Linear: +1 long / −1 short in the primary risk factor
Options: Black–Scholes-type delta, σ = 50% (λ shift where rates can be negative)
D_k = Σ δ_i · d_i · MF_i over the trades of hedging set j in bucket k
Full offset of long and short positions inside the same bucket
Trades in more than one time bucket?
SF × ½ for basis sets, × 5 for volatility sets; single bucket: EN = |D_k|
AddOn_IR = Σ_j AddOn_j (no offset across currencies)
Other asset classes in the netting set?
AddOn_agg = Σ AddOn over IR, FX, CR, EQ, CO (+ other risks, CRR only)
Dashed amber = decision point. Grey chips = Basel CRE52 paragraph / EU CRR article.
